workflow.title: Initial Consultation
workflow.description: Book your appointment and meet with our team. We listen to your concerns, discuss your dental goals, and assess your current oral health.

workflow.title: Personalised Treatment Plan
workflow.description: Based on your consultation, we create a customised treatment plan tailored to your unique needs and smile goals.

workflow.title: Expert Treatment
workflow.description: Our skilled dentists and specialists deliver your treatment using advanced techniques and state-of-the-art technology in a relaxing environment.

workflow.title: Ongoing Care & Support
workflow.description: We provide follow-up appointments, maintenance care, and preventive guidance to ensure your smile stays healthy and beautiful long-term.

faqs.question: Why is preventive care important?
faqs.answer: Prevention is the key to long-term dental health. Regular check-ups, professional cleanings, and patient education help detect problems early, ensuring timely intervention and reducing the need for extensive treatments.

faqs.question: What if I'm nervous about visiting the dentist?
faqs.answer: Our compassionate team is experienced in providing gentle dentistry for anxious patients. We create a comfortable environment and offer various sedation options to help alleviate your fears and ensure a stress-free experience.

faqs.question: Do you treat children as well as adults?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a wide range of services for all ages. From paediatric dentistry with preventive treatments and education for children, to cosmetic and restorative options for adults, we ensure every family member receives the highest level of care.

faqs.question: What is involved in a smile makeover?
faqs.answer: A smile makeover requires careful planning and may address concerns like chipped teeth, crooked teeth, gaps, or discolouration. Our skilled cosmetic dentists work with you to improve both aesthetics and oral health, with transformative results that are well worth the investment.

faqs.question: How does Invisalign compare to other orthodontic options?
faqs.answer: Invisalign offers a discreet, comfortable way to straighten your teeth. Our team can discuss how Invisalign and other advanced orthodontic solutions compare to help you choose the best option for your smile goals.

faqs.question: Are dental implants a good solution for missing teeth?
faqs.answer: Yes, dental implants are the most advanced solution available today for replacing natural teeth. They restore both function and confidence, offering a durable, natural-looking result.

reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Fantastic service from start to finish. My Invisalign treatment has completely transformed my teeth. The staff at Brighouse are knowledgeable, friendly, and really put you at ease.

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: We've been taking the whole family to The Temple Practice for years. The dentists are brilliant with the children, and the relaxing environment makes visits stress-free for everyone.

reviews.text: Had my dental implants done at Temple Practice and the results are outstanding. Professional team, state-of-the-art technology, and exceptional care throughout the entire process. Highly recommend.
